edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Preserved the bracketed in Ephesus, repeated blessing/glory/grace, adoption, blood, inheritance, sealing/pledge, heart’s eyes, the several power terms and head/body/fullness images. Smoothed abundance and prayer wording. At 1:10–11 kept both in-Him expressions while joining the first to 1:10, as in the displayed NA28 punctuation, and beginning 1:11 with an English main clause. Retained your at 1:18, bracketed in NA28.

chapters.decision: Preserved dead/alive, walking, age/world/air, flesh, wrath, the together repetitions, completed have been saved, workmanship, blood, peace/hostility, two/one and household/building images. Smoothed the opening sentence and wishes clause, replaced ordinary ye, and clarified the new-human-being construction. Retained this at 2:8 without naming a disputed antecedent. At 2:15, in Him reflects the consulted NA28 pronoun; the earlier in Himself is archived and its possible reflexive sense remains noted.

chapters.decision: Preserved imitation, walking, offering/aroma, darkness/light, fruit, buying up opportunity, songs, heart, submission to one another, washing, body/bride, spot/wrinkle and two/one flesh. Modernized third-person verbs, rendered fellow partakers as fellow sharers, and clarified dissipation as reckless excess. Retained fruit of light at 5:9, fear of Christ at 5:21, the verbless continuation at 5:22, and the shorter 5:30. Kept in at 5:19 and also at 5:28, bracketed in NA28.
